title: Orbit and Machine
author: Felix Oyelaran
blurb: Noor Oyelaran, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
